title: feat(studio): the object designer opens full-screen on its metadata address, tabs in #36513's order
body:
Fixes #36904
Refs #36513 (its section 一, the tab order, is delivered here; its section 二 was superseded by epic #36890)
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- Studio 里点开一个对象，设计器在右侧整屏打开，有自己的地址；左上角 × 回对象列表，右上角 ‹ › 看上一个、下一个，设计器左边那一列对象列表没有了。
- 这是 Studio 改版专题里的对象设计器一张，也按之前定的把对象页签排成：记录、字段布局、验证、操作、设置、钩子、API。
- 出错时管理员会打不开或改不了对象（Studio 最常用的路径），旧链接也会落到对象列表；整张合并即可撤回。
- 这张约 4200 行（4,177 行），超过 3000 行：其中删掉的测试约 1700 行（六个整份删掉的测试文件约 1000 行，测的是左侧列表、页内新建、空包页面和实时请求，这些本卡都去掉了），改写和新增的测试约 1000 行，产品代码约 1400 行；需要您审核后合并。

## What changes

- **The object designer is full-screen on the object's address**, `/studio/PKG/metadata/object/NAME`, mounted by the "All metadata" area (`StudioMetadataArea`). The area decides it with the zone's shared designer-page helper from #37089: `AREA_DESIGNER_PAGE_TYPES`, `areaItemOpensDesignerPage({ packageId, type })` and `areaDesignerItemOf(pathname, segment)`, which reads `new` as the create page, never an item. #37089 landed first; this branch merged main, so the one list now holds both types, `['permission', 'object']`, and `AreaItemOpen` mounts the permission set's matrix or the object designer by type. For an object, the environment scope and `?review=1` keep the generic page, as the pillar did (`areaItemAsksGenericPage`, shared with `areaItemPillarPath`); the permission page keeps #37089's behaviour and opens on any query. The header is the shared full-screen item header (`ResourceDetailHeader`): × back to the object list with the list's filter and sort, ‹ › through the list, Esc. No switcher, no "open in app" (epic decision 7).
- **No left list, no in-page New.** `DataPillar` takes `objectName` and designs that one object: the object rail, its search and customization filter, the in-page 新建 dialog and the empty-package state are gone. Creating an object is the object list's 「新建」 (`MetadataListCreateDialog`, #36897), which already has the OWD choice, the app-menu join and the read-only base's `.custom` landing; checked before deleting this copy.
- **Tabs in #36513's order**, verbatim: 记录、字段布局、验证、操作、设置、钩子、API (`objectDesignerTabs.ts`). Narrow columns fold Hooks and API into "Advanced" first (below 1200px), then the other three (below 1000px); each trigger's menu lists only what is folded at its width (`dataTabsFold.ts`). The five header icons became tabs through the shared `ItemToolTabs` (hand-off brief): References, History (audit log inside), Source (layers inside). The open tab is `?tab=` in the address, carried by ‹ ›.
- **The address switch.** `object` leaves `STUDIO_ITEM_PILLAR`, so every `studioItemPath` producer opens the new address: the app's 「对象设置」 (`appStudioObjectPath`), the record page's 「配置页面」 (`recordTabsStudioPath`), ⌘K, the AI artifact link, and the switched-off action link (`?action=NAME` on the new address). `/studio/PKG/data` redirects (`dataPillarRedirect`): with `?surface=object:NAME` to that object's designer (`?action=` kept; `?view=`, `?nav=` dropped), otherwise to the object list (`?changes=review`, the server's draft-review link, kept). A `.custom` pair's old address lands on the pair's own area. An object request from the Changes sheet navigates to the object's address in the package that holds the draft (`draftScope`: on a read-only base, its `.custom` pair).
- **`AreaHistoryRedirect`:** objects no longer take the designer-item exemption (`/metadata/object/NAME/history` opens the designer's History tab). The line itself stays for flows until #36903; removing it now would send a flow's history to the flow pillar and lose it.
- Kept as the card asks: the copilot's 「对象 · 页签」 chip and the AI-change line. The copilot read the open item only from `?surface=`, which the new address does not carry, so it now also reads it from the designer's address (`areaDesignerItemOf`, as #37089 does).
- Fixed on the way: a partly refused AI-drafts discard kept its message for one render only (the object re-read the discard triggers cleared `error`); it is now its own state. The retired-Interfaces notice is latched on the landing path, not the pillar, since the home is the area's object list now.

### This rework round (L1 7149684173)

- **M1:** the rail-switch suite's four cases are carried onto the designer's × and › on the real surface (`StudioDesignSurface.heldDataLeave-26705`, new top-level describe): an unsaved edit that is not held asks on › and ×; an edit whose Save was refused asks; a saved edit leaves without asking; nothing pending leaves at once and sends nothing.
- **S2:** the Changes-sheet object link uses `draftScope ?? packageId` (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`), pinned in `heldDataCreate-26845` (a read-only base with a listed pair lands on the pair's address).
- **S3:** `/metadata/object/X/history` opens the designer on History (`StudioMetadataArea.routes-28561`); `?tab=hooks` and `?tab=history` open those tabs, `?tab=nonsense` opens Records (`DataPillar.flatTabs-12450`).
- **S4:** `copilotChangesLine-34725` asserts the partly-refused discard's message is still on screen after the object re-read.
- **S5:** metadata-address cases in `studioSurfaceContext` (the object, its history address, and the create page, the list and a generic item naming nothing) and `studioSurfaceLabel-8219` (the chip shows the label only for the object the address names).
- **S6:** `ui/packages/app-shell/README.md` sends an object to its designer's address; the changeset is rewritten in user terms.
- **S7:** `areaItemOpensObjectDesigner` and `metadataAddressArtifact` are replaced by #37089's helper (above); after #37089 landed, main is merged and the list holds both types.
- **N8, found on the browser walk:** an address naming no object offered it as an "Unpublished new object"; it now says "Object not found" (`objMissing`, `DataPillar.tsx`; pinned in `draftOnlyNoLayers-12508`).
- **Added by seat a4-S:** the object create publishes pinned (`publishCreated`, `If-None-Match: *`), as the flow create does, so an object another writer published under the name since the check is refused, not replaced. Pinned in `MetadataListCreateDialog.pairCreate-36897`, with the in-package taken notice and its Open.
- **N2, N3, N4:** stale comments corrected (`SidebarItemMenu.tsx`, `studioAddressTable.ts`, `studioInterfacesRetired.ts`, the header-label comment in `DataPillar.tsx`, which now says what the code does: the draft's label when there is one); two controls carried over (a package with no namespace previews and saves the bare identifier, in `MetadataListCreateDialog.pairCreate-36897`; a label-less draft-only object is titled by its name, in `DataPillar.draftOnlyNoLayers-12508`). **N7:** `areaDesignerItemOf` reads `/metadata/object/new` as the create page.

## Tests

- New: `objectDesignerTabs.test.ts` (order word for word, address round trip, tool tabs, values that open nothing); `metadataArea.test.ts` (the designer-page helper, `dataPillarRedirect`, `areaDesignerItemOf`); `DataPillar.flatTabs-12450` rewritten for the ruled order, the two-step fold and `?tab=`.
- Rehosted on the list dialog (the create's home now): the OWD default, the stored-name preview (with and without a namespace) and the taken-identifier refusal into `MetadataListCreateDialog.pairCreate-36897`; the app-menu join suite, the OWD select, the labels and the taken-identifier object block onto `MetadataListCreateDialog`.
- Converted: about 60 designer and surface suites now open the object on its address (`objectName`, area routes).
- Deleted, behaviour removed by this card, each with the pin that remains: `StudioDesignSurface.emptyPackage` (no in-page empty state), `StudioDesignSurface.createObjectOwd` (duplicated in `MetadataListCreateDialog.pairCreate-36897`: chosen and default `sharingModel`, `mode: 'draft'`), `DataPillar.railSwitchFlush-27511` (its four cases now on the designer's × and ›, `heldDataLeave-26705`), `DataPillar.surfaceRequest` (the pillar's own live-request apply; the surface's navigation is pinned in `heldDataCreate-26845`), `DataPillar.draftObjectLabel-11843` (the rail's label read; the header's label is pinned in `draftOnlyNoLayers-12508`, both the labelled and the label-less draft), `StudioDesignSurface.aiApplyRefresh` (the rail growing on the pulse); and the rail-only cases inside `autosaveSwitch-11232`, `celGate`, `actionDeepLink-34724`, `heldDataLeave-26705` (the rail switch case became × back to the list), `StudioRail.noMatches-26733` (Data rail), `oneSurface-28572` (pair rows on the rail).

## Acceptance notes

- **S8, fixed (added by seat a4-S from the #37169 L1, 7152310574):** the list dialog's taken-name notice tells the two cases apart. When the package the create writes to holds the object, it reads `engine.studio.data.createTaken` (read again) and offers 「打开」, which opens that object's designer (`studioItemPath`). When the holder is elsewhere, it keeps `createTakenElsewhere` and offers no Open. The `onOpenExisting` prop has the same shape as #37169's flow side.
- **i18n keys:** the released `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` keys this PR leaves unread are kept (the optional drop from ruling 7153326968 is not taken). `Clause-②` stays `no`.
- **Header shows the machine name beside the label (N4):** the designer's header is the shared full-screen item header, which shows the API name beside the label, as every Studio item page does; #34794 kept it in the tooltip on the old pillar header. Kept, for one header across Studio's item pages.
- **N1, for #36909:** `useRequestedSurface` has no product reader left after this card; #36909 (route and remnant deletion) removes it with the pillar routes.
- **N2, for #36909:** the retired-Interfaces redirect goes `/interfaces` → `/data` → the object list, two hops; the hop through `/data` goes when #36909 retires `STUDIO_HOME_PILLAR` and the pillar routes. Only the stale comments are fixed here.
- **N8, fixed:** the browser walk showed that an address naming no object did not show a refusal strip but offered the name as an "Unpublished new object" to design. It now says "Object not found" (an existing `@object-ui/i18n` string, `engine.form.objectNotFound`) under the header, whose × goes back to the list.
- **For #36903:** `AreaHistoryRedirect`'s designer-item exemption line now serves flows only; #36903 deletes it when the flow designer moves.
- **Old base address of a pair's object:** `/studio/BASE/data?surface=object:PAIR_OBJECT` (what the retired rail mirrored for an object the `.custom` pair adds) now redirects to the base's area, where that name does not resolve; the pair's own address works, and the object list and the Changes sheet link pair objects to it.
- **Paused #36784** (public forms, now closed): it conflicted textually with this branch on `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, the Data pillar mount removed here.
- **Main merged after #37089 (#36905, the permission designer) landed:** 15 files conflicted, all resolved toward both designers (the shared list, the area's mount by type, the copilot comment, the menu model's named designer types, the sharing overview's route beside the object designer's reports, and the test files' collection-time imports and pillar lists). **Main merged again after #37185 landed** (`64a5a2d7`): two conflicts, each resolved by hand. `StudioDesignSurface.entryReadsOnce-11797.test.tsx` and `StudioDesignSurface.itemDraftLine-12725.test.tsx` both kept the collection-time `@object-ui/plugin-detail` import; only main's explanatory comment beside it differed, and main's comment was taken. `StudioDesignSurface.readOnlyPosture-12453.test.tsx` auto-merged and keeps both sides: this PR's designer address in `PILLARS` and #37185's header-carrying fetch doubles. Sibling drafts #37169 (#36903, flow designer) and #37166 still conflict textually; whichever lands later merges main.
- Size: over 3,000 changed lines, Tier H by size (maintainer ruling recorded on epic #36890, comment 7145880574).

Two-minute check: on the showcase app, open an app's 「对象设置」. Expected: the URL is `/studio/PKG/metadata/object/NAME`, the designer fills the right pane with no object column, the tabs read 记录、字段布局、验证、操作、设置、钩子、API、被引用、历史、源码; › opens the next object on the same tab; × returns to the object list.
